Name: Map Tweaks
Author: SpaghettiLord1010
Description:
This mod changes the smaller, less used Maps to make them look prettier and give it a purpose.
It will be compatible with any mod which doesn't change eather the bus stop, the cellar or the greenhouse.


This won't work with CP Immersive Farm 2 due to the custom Maps from that mod.


You can also get this mod on [url=https://spaghettilord1010.itch.io/stardew-valley-mods]Itch.io[/url].

Added some screenshots because of demand.
